inputClaimId.title: inputClaimId
inputClaimId.description: Internal unique identifier for the warranty claim, such as a Salesforce record ID or system-generated claim key. Used for precise data retrieval when available; may be derived by the system from the claim reference.

inputClaimName.title: inputClaimName
inputClaimName.description: Warranty claim reference provided by the user. May be expressed as a numeric value (847, 0847) or a prefixed format such as WC-2026-0847. All formats refer to the same claim.
